alternative.strategy: In-memory API sorting matching public SQLite NOCASE semantics

external_checks.inputs: Original baseline, public contract/FAQ/policy/docs only; no reference/alternative or previous outcomes
external_checks.requirements: Freeze black-box public/sealed checks before target-dependent repairs; actual wrong-sort/tie/invalid/UI/ownership negative patches must be qualified before primary dispatch

roles.cross_review: Different authorized model in fresh session for each substantive artifact; no self-approval or family-independent claim

public_inputs: Original baseline + public C2 scope + exact prospective policy + approved docs. No C1 outcomes, implementations, hidden checks or conversations.
harness: OpenCode -> private LiteLLM -> pinned ZDR OpenRouter. Unscored isolated fixture-authoring surface, docs file copy; primary Context/Podman harness stays separate.

cross_review_appointments.prompts_authored_by: AI coordinator, Codex; exact current coordinator model not exposed in per-artifact native evidence
cross_review_appointments.author_provenance_limit: Coordinator draft prompts require subject-model review before primary freeze; no family-independent claim.
cross_review_appointments.checks_review_inputs: Original baseline/public scope/policy/docs + frozen check suite only; no candidate implementations/outcomes.
cross_review_appointments.candidate_review_inputs: Original baseline/public scope/policy/docs + anonymized unmodified first source snapshots; no conversations or comparative outcomes.
cross_review_appointments.dispatch_order: After first GLM check-builder endpoint and supported backup, sequential fresh isolated sessions.
